application_events_status_fields_match_t.name: application_events_status_fields_match_type
application_events_status_fields_match_t.value:
("application_events"."type"::text = 'status_change') = ("application_events"."to_status" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("application_events"."from_status" IS NULL OR "application_events"."type"::text = 'status_change')

application_pitches_bullets_three.name: application_pitches_bullets_three
application_pitches_bullets_three.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("application_pitches"."bullets") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("application_pitches"."bullets") = 3 ELSE false END

cover_letters_paragraphs_four_or_five.name: cover_letters_paragraphs_four_or_five
cover_letters_paragraphs_four_or_five.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("cover_letters"."paragraphs") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("cover_letters"."paragraphs") BETWEEN 4 AND 5 ELSE false END

generated_documents_source_matches_kind.name: generated_documents_source_matches_kind
generated_documents_source_matches_kind.value:
("generated_documents"."resume_optimization_id" IS NULL OR "generated_documents"."kind"::text = 'resume')
        AND ("generated_documents"."application_pitch_id" IS NULL OR "generated_documents"."kind"::text = 'pitch')
        AND ("generated_documents"."cover_letter_id" IS NULL OR "generated_documents"."kind"::text = 'cover_letter')
        AND ("generated_documents"."interview_preparation_id" IS NULL OR "generated_documents"."kind"::text = 'interview_prep')

skill_verifications_fields_match_status.name: skill_verifications_fields_match_status
skill_verifications_fields_match_status.value:
("skill_verifications"."status" = 'have' AND "skill_verifications"."evidence" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_verifications"."alias_skill_name" IS NULL)
        OR ("skill_verifications"."status" = 'dont_have' AND "skill_verifications"."evidence" IS NULL AND "skill_verifications"."alias_skill_name" IS NULL)
        OR ("skill_verifications"."status" = 'alias' AND "skill_verifications"."evidence" IS NULL AND "skill_verifications"."alias_skill_name" IS NOT NULL)
